scenario_provenance.archetype_label: Inference: a significance test or confidence interval
validity_rules: one-proportion significance-test setting with stated H0 and Ha
p-value interpretation must be conditional on H0 being true
tail event must be as extreme as or more extreme than the observed sample result in the direction of Ha

sources.note: the item stem's verb must match the scored demand

prompt: A significance test is performed using a random sample of app sessions to test H0: p = 0.04 against Ha: p > 0.04, where p is the proportion of all app sessions that end with a crash. The sample result was the sample crash rate was above 0.04, and the p-value is 0.063. Which statement correctly interprets the p-value in context?

options.text: There is about a 6.3% chance that the null hypothesis is true.

misconception_source.label: Interpreted the p-value as the probability that the null hypothesis is true

sources.note: p-value interpretation must be conditional on the null hypothesis and tied to results as extreme as the observed result

options.text: If the proportion of all app sessions that end with a crash really is 0.04, then there is about a 6.3% chance of getting a sample proportion this small or smaller by random sampling alone.

misconception_source.label: Reversed the direction of the extreme-tail event

sources.note: p-value meaning depends on the alternative-hypothesis direction and the corresponding tail event

options.text: There is about a 6.3% chance that the alternative hypothesis is true.

misconception_source.label: Interpreted the p-value as evidence that the alternative hypothesis is true with that probability

sources.note: significance-test interpretation distinguishes evidence against H0 from posterior probability that Ha is true

options.text: If the proportion of all app sessions that end with a crash really is 0.04, then there is about a 6.3% chance of getting a sample result at least as large as the one in the sample (a sample proportion at least this large) by random sampling alone.

criteria.description: Selects the interpretation of a p-value as a conditional tail probability under H0 in context.
criteria.required_evidence: Correctly conditions on H0 and refers to a result as extreme as or more extreme than the observed result.

provenance.note: Authored conceptual frame; correctness from p-value interpretation taxonomy.
